stream.chosen_source: Seeded uniform top/bottom choice executed by common legal three-action physical navigation; update all learned methods only with actual observed terminated and reward.

fairness: Only early cue identity and later candidate identities supplied to learned policies; shared public full-grid navigation actor resolves chosen branch using original FullyObsWrapper; cannot inspect success_pos/failure_pos. Native and conventional receive identical actual FIT experiences, explicit feature-inductive-bias is equality of remembered cue and candidate, retained in both. Upper bound uses semantic equality rule, not learned.
scope: Shared scripted navigation means this probes delayed-cue memory and reward-conditioned association only, NOT autonomous navigation or general intelligence.

frozen_criteria.source_gate: Require >=16 positive and >=16 negative goal results per size in real FIT, and both cue and chosen branch identities. Otherwise holdout not consumed.
frozen_criteria.bounded: Native >=12/16 DEV goals per size and >=4/16 more than cue-ablated memoryless policy per size; no worse than fitted conventional one-bit learner by more than 1/16.
frozen_criteria.novelty: If conventional lookup ties or exceeds native, no native advantage or better resource Pareto; no scientific first use.
frozen_criteria.resource: Retain complete per-step public action traces, cold checkpoint hashes/bytes, genuine goal rewards, policy CPU/wall and whole RSS; no FLOP/energy claims.
